mechanisms.decisive_claim: If sum_j 1/d_j converges, the progression union has logarithmic density and is upper-log approximable by finite periodic unions.
mechanisms.kill_test: Bound the entire tail union by its reciprocal-modulus sum uniformly in the cutoff.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/tractable_tail_criteria.md: bounded ratio makes both reciprocal target and modulus tails summable, giving finite-periodic natural-density approximation

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If d_j-r_j takes values in a fixed finite set, the union has logarithmic density.
mechanisms.kill_test: Transform each fixed offset family to a shifted set of multiples and prove finite-union upper-log approximation.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/tractable_tail_criteria.md and preceding campaign evidence/affine_echo_multiples_theorem.md: fixed offsets are shifted sets of multiples and finite unions have upper-log periodic approximation

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For pairwise coprime d_j, every least-representative progression union has logarithmic density: finite density if the reciprocal sum converges and density one if it diverges.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use exact CRT independence for finite complements and control the activation tail.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/tractable_tail_criteria.md and evidence/tail_criteria_replay.json: CRT product dichotomy; extended to finite-colourable gcd dependency graphs

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For fixed C, every finite batch of newly uncovered targets has transient harmonic mass at most K(C) times the eventual new periodic density plus a summable boundary error.
mechanisms.kill_test: Optimise exact finite systems for growth of the transient-to-new-density ratio at fixed C.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/finite_almost_packing_corollary.md and evidence/multiplication_table_obstruction_replay.json: annular r=d-1 batches are target-irredundant, satisfy C<2, yet their first N-echo union is an o(N^2) multiplication-table subset

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Quantising d_j/r_j into finitely many slope bins changes the union by arbitrarily small upper logarithmic density.
mechanisms.kill_test: Perturb a modulus by one while holding its least representative fixed and measure congruence disagreement.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A uniform pairwise-gcd second-moment bound alone forces logarithmic-density existence for the infinite union.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct finite CRT systems with identical first two intersection data but incompatible higher-order uncovered mass.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/finite_almost_packing_corollary.md, evidence/multiplication_table_obstruction_replay.json, and Gilboa--Pinchasi arXiv:1310.4348: uniform constant second-moment packing is false even in the exact target-irredundant bounded-ratio subclass

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A fixed finite-rule non-affine schedule with certified positive inner density has signed logarithmic rises and drops bounded away from zero.
mechanisms.kill_test: Freeze rules after training and extend blindly over successively larger cutoffs, scoring only several most-recent signed cycles.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/fixed_rule_blind_analysis.json: 16 of 24 frozen schedules have at least two rises and two drops entirely after training, but 15 of those 16 have negative post-training amplitude slopes and the four training-comparable floors retain only a 0.0615 median fraction; finite oscillation survives while a positive asymptotic lower bound is unsupported

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Greedily attacking every available point in alternating multiplicative blocks yields a nonvanishing fixed-rule oscillation.
mechanisms.kill_test: Track attacked-cell saturation and the decay of recent recovery drops under fixed-rule extension.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There is a universal K(C) bounding total first-representative logarithmic charge by accumulated periodic density loss for every prefix.
mechanisms.kill_test: Search exact high-overlap batches at fixed small C for an unbounded charge-to-density ratio.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/tractable_tail_criteria.md and evidence/tail_criteria_replay.json: exact prime-saturation counterexample to a universal linear first-representative-charge bound

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A large full-history endpoint range is sufficient finite evidence for a nonvanishing infinite oscillation.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare the range champion's most-recent signed rises and drops after fixed-cutoff extension.
mechanisms.status_evidence: preceding campaign evidence/confined_champion_extension.json and current strict signed gate: full-history range can be monotone or supported only by early cycles and is not evidence of a nonzero limsup/liminf gap

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Bounded echo delay yields a renewal dichotomy: reciprocal immigration is summable, or the attacked component saturates, leaving no recurrent intermediate-density tail.
mechanisms.kill_test: Derive the claim without independence and stress it on gcd-confined self-similar schedules.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A countable union of affine echo charts has logarithmic density whenever the charts admit finite periodic approximants whose upper-log remainder bounds are summable.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove a diagonal finite-periodic approximation with the sum of chart remainders controlling the global tail.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/tractable_tail_criteria.md: diagonal finite-periodic approximation, with the summable chart remainders controlling the union tail

mechanisms.decisive_claim: At fixed C, target irredundancy and monotone r_j,d_j impose a uniform bound on later echo collision multiplicity.
mechanisms.kill_test: Construct an arbitrarily large irredundant family with r_j<d_j<=2r_j whose progressions share one later point.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/local_entropy_route.md and evidence/tail_criteria_replay.json: the lcm(1,...,2H)-1 construction gives H irredundant collisions for arbitrary H, verified at H=80

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Affine confinement R_j=a+g r_j,D_j=g d_j preserves the same bounded-ratio constant and preserves logarithmic-density existence while placing the union in one positive-capacity cell.
mechanisms.kill_test: Check every order and ratio inequality and transfer lower and upper logarithmic densities through n maps to a+gn.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/confinement_equivalence.md: exact affine lift and O(sum 1/n^2) harmonic transfer; parity caveat for the earlier Erdos embedding retained

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The Gilboa--Pinchasi n^epsilon almost-packing loss can be scheduled with scale-dependent epsilon and explicit constants to give a summable logarithmic tail bound at fixed C.
mechanisms.kill_test: Extract explicit c(epsilon), optimise epsilon on each logarithmic scale, and test whether the resulting loss is summable rather than merely subpolynomial.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/finite_almost_packing_corollary.md and evidence/literature_boundary.md: the finite n^epsilon loss is valid, but no scale-uniform explicit c(epsilon) or summable multiscale schedule was obtained

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Any n bounded-ratio progressions activated in one target scale have first ell-echo union harmonic mass at least c(epsilon) min(n^(1-epsilon),ell)/(C R).
mechanisms.kill_test: Apply the asymmetric Gilboa--Pinchasi finite-union theorem and retain the exact endpoint and harmonic-weight losses.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every target-irredundant bounded-ratio batch with multiplication-table-scale collision has most of its progressions in finitely many affine offset charts, enabling the affine density theorem after a summable decomposition.
mechanisms.kill_test: Search monotone non-affine offset staircases with at least sqrt(N) offsets and no majority chart for multiplication-table-scale first-echo unions.
mechanisms.status_evidence: evidence/nonaffine_annular_packing_comparison.json: two guarded seeds found finite non-affine champions at N=525 and N=507, but their union fractions were respectively 1.2288 and 1.3027 times the same-moduli fixed-offset comparator; exact replays passed and no multiplication-table-scale diffuse-chart batch was found
